title: Integrity-checked cross-site file transfer
summary: Idempotent remote transfer uses content verification and atomic finalization while preserving conflicting destinations.

dates.note: Exact start/end dates are not documented. Technical mechanisms are reported in the October 5, 2026 snapshot; any later owner clarifications are cited per fact.

facts.text: Implemented cross-site file transfer with run-owned partial destinations, SHA-256 verification, idempotent reuse of matching files and atomic finalization.
Refused replacement of conflicting destinations and restricted retry cleanup to the current run-owned partial path.
Retries restart the transfer; the supplied source does not establish byte-level checkpoint resumption.
